content.title: Whoever wins Warner Bros. deal will 'transform the media industry'
content.description:
Netflix (NFLX) and Paramount (PSKY) are fighting to buy parts of Warner Bros. Discovery's (WBD) business.

content.title: What is a hostile takeover bid?
content.summary: Paramount Skydance on Monday launched a hostile takeover bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, moving directly to appeal to shareholders with an all-cash offer that it says represents better value than the $72 billion deal Netflix and WBD announced Friday.

thumbnail.caption: (L-R:) Warner Bros. Discovery CEO David Zaslav; Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison. - Emma McIntyre/Getty Images/Evan Agostini/Invision/AP

content.title: What to Know About the Battle for Warner Bros. Discovery
content.summary: Now that Paramount has made a hostile takeover bid for Warner Bros. Discovery, a drama is about to play out. Warner has said it is reviewing Paramount’s offer, and meanwhile continues to recommend that shareholders support its deal with Netflix, which they will get to vote on at a later date.
